name: DDO 44 (Hubble)
blurb: DDO 44, a dwarf spheroidal galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ddo44-hubble
story: A faint dwarf spheroidal galaxy and a likely companion of the spiral NGC 2403, which Hubble resolves into a scatter of individual stars. About 20% of its brightest stars are of intermediate age.

claims.text: DDO 44 is a dwarf spheroidal galaxy
DDO 44 is a likely companion of NGC 2403
DDO 44 is also designated UGCA 133 and KK 61
Hubble imaged DDO 44 in the ACS Nearby Galaxy Survey, which resolves nearby galaxies into individual stars
About 20% of its brightest stars are of intermediate age
